title: Supreme Court to hear challenge to detentions at heart of Trump's deportations
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Supreme Court to hear challenge to detentions at heart of Trump's deportations

The Supreme Court said Thursday it has agreed to take up a case challenging the Trump administration's claim that it can detain migrants without having to give them a bond hearing even if they've been living inside the country for years.

The [Supreme Court](/topics/supreme-court/) said Thursday it has agreed to take up a case challenging the [Trump administration’s](/topics/trump-administration/) claim that it can detain migrants without having to give them a bond hearing even if they’ve been living inside the country for years.

The mandatory detention policy is critical to [President Trump’s](/topics/president-trump/) mass deportation campaign.

Experts say that if illegal immigrants are detained, they can be deported relatively quickly. But if they’re released from custody, it becomes much tougher to boot them.

Migrants arriving at the border have long been subject to mandatory detention, but past administrations treated those already in the interior differently.
